# Niya Skin Atelier

Niya is a private cosmetologist offering gentle, personalized facial care.
The site is available in Russian and Turkish.

## Services

- Skin consultation and personalized care plan: 600 TRY, 45 minutes.
- Delicate cleansing: 1400 TRY, 75 minutes.
- Hydration ritual: 1600 TRY, 60 minutes.
- Gentle renewal / superficial peel: 1200 TRY, 45 minutes.
- Sculpting facial massage: 1300 TRY, 60 minutes.
- Full pause ritual with massage and mask: 2100 TRY, 90 minutes.

## Contact

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/niya_cosmetolog/
- Booking: use the booking form on the website or Instagram.

Prices are demonstration values until the cosmetologist confirms the final menu.
